description.value: You keep two versions of every deal straight in your head without blinking. If your Lie is caught out, you can spend a reaction to immediately offer a second, consistent lie; the target must reroll their Perception check to catch this one at no bonus or penalty.

cinderfall.incomplete: Granting a reaction to offer a second lie, forcing the target to reroll their own Perception check at no bonus/penalty, is both a new reaction grant (see Reactive Shield precedent) and an effect on another creature's own roll (bucket 4) -- neither has a rule-element hook.
